stem_md: 设 $u=\varphi[x+\\psi(y)]$，下列等式正确的是哪一个？
analysis_md:
由于 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\varphi',\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\varphi'\psi',\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}=\varphi''\psi',\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}=\varphi''$

因此：$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}=\varphi'\psi'\varphi''=\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}$
